
# Load models and data
```{r}
# load model
m11d_co100_zln = readRDS(file = here("size_bd_unified/unified_models/unified_model_results_zln_m11d_co100_20260926_174424_with_loo.rds"))
model_select = m11d_co100_zln

# load life history
ls_in = read_csv(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "iucn_habitat_metrics.csv"))

ls_clean = ls_in %>%
  mutate(log_habitat_breadth = log(habitat_breadth))

# phylogenetic tree
jp_phylo_tree = read.tree(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "phylo_tree.nwk"))
# correlation matrix (diag = 1) so sd_taxon_capture is on the same scale as sigma
# and the phylogenetic signal hypotheses below read as Pagel's lambda
jp_phylo_cov = ape::vcv.phylo(jp_phylo_tree, corr = TRUE)

set_cmdstan_path(Sys.getenv("cmd_stan_path"))
```

# linpred draws
```{r}
f_draw_agg <- function(draws, group_vars, agg_var) {
  
  draws |>
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) |>
    reframe(
      "{agg_var}_lower_50" := tidybayes::median_qi(.data[[agg_var]], .width = 0.50)[, 2],
      "{agg_var}_upper_50" := tidybayes::median_qi(.data[[agg_var]], .width = 0.50)[, 3],
      "{agg_var}_lower_95" := tidybayes::median_qi(.data[[agg_var]], .width = 0.95)[, 2],
      "{agg_var}_upper_95" := tidybayes::median_qi(.data[[agg_var]], .width = 0.95)[, 3],
      "{agg_var}_median"   := median(.data[[agg_var]]),
      "{agg_var}_net_effect" := (sum(.data[[agg_var]] > 0) / n()) * 2 - 1
    )
}

mmode = function(x) {
  ux = unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}


# define linpred data
nd_env_subadult = model_select$data %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple) %>%
  summarize(precip_mm_10_z = median(precip_mm_10_z),
            temp_c_30_z = median(temp_c_30_z),
            kg_code_3 = mmode(kg_code_3),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(life_stage_simple == "subadult")

nd_spp_lss = model_select$data |>
  distinct(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple) %>%
  left_join(nd_env_subadult %>%
              select(-life_stage_simple), by = "taxon_capture")

# include taxon-specific env slopes (fixed + r_taxon_capture) so each species' linpred
# at its median env uses its own slopes, not the population-average slopes.
# sigma has no taxon env slopes in m11d, so this is equivalent to NA for sigma.
re_spp_env = ~ (0 + precip_mm_10_z + temp_c_30_z + I(temp_c_30_z^2) | taxon_capture)

# hu contrast
hu_spp_lss_draws = model_select |>
  linpred_draws(
    newdata    = nd_spp_lss,
    dpar       = "hu",
    re_formula = re_spp_env
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

hu_spp_draws = hu_spp_lss_draws |>
  group_by(taxon_capture, .draw) |>
  summarise(hu = mean(hu), .groups = "drop")

hu_spp_lss_contrast_draws = hu_spp_lss_draws |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(taxon_capture, .draw),
    names_from  = life_stage_simple,
    values_from = hu
  ) |>
  mutate(hu_contrast = subadult - adult,
         contrast = "subadult - adult")

# mu 
mu_spp_lss_draws = model_select |>
  linpred_draws(
    newdata    = nd_spp_lss,
    dpar       = "mu",
    re_formula = re_spp_env
  ) %>% ungroup()

mu_spp_lss_contrast_draws = mu_spp_lss_draws |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(taxon_capture, .draw),
    names_from  = life_stage_simple,
    values_from = mu
  ) |>
  mutate(mu_contrast = subadult - adult,
         contrast = "subadult - adult")

# sigma (link scale, i.e. log(sigma))
sigma_spp_lss_draws = model_select |>
  linpred_draws(
    newdata    = nd_spp_lss,
    dpar       = "sigma",
    re_formula = re_spp_env
  ) %>% ungroup()

sigma_spp_draws = sigma_spp_lss_draws |>
  group_by(taxon_capture, .draw) |>
  summarise(sigma = mean(sigma), .groups = "drop")


hu_spp_agg = f_draw_agg(hu_spp_draws, c("taxon_capture"), "hu")
prevalence_spp_agg = f_draw_agg(hu_spp_draws %>%
                                    mutate(prevalence = 1 - plogis(hu)), c("taxon_capture"), "prevalence")
sigma_spp_agg = f_draw_agg(sigma_spp_draws, c("taxon_capture"), "sigma")
mu_spp_lss_contrast_agg = f_draw_agg(mu_spp_lss_contrast_draws, c("taxon_capture", "contrast"), "mu_contrast")
hu_spp_lss_contrast_agg = f_draw_agg(hu_spp_lss_contrast_draws, c("taxon_capture", "contrast"), "hu_contrast")

# combine
spp_draws = hu_spp_draws %>%
  mutate(prevalence = 1 - plogis(hu)) %>%
  left_join(sigma_spp_draws, by = c(".draw", "taxon_capture"))


spp_lss_draws = hu_spp_lss_draws %>%
  select(taxon_capture,
         life_stage_simple,
         .draw,
         hu) %>%
  mutate(prevalence = 1 - plogis(hu)) %>%
  left_join(mu_spp_lss_draws %>%
              select(taxon_capture,
                     life_stage_simple,
                     .draw,
                     mu), by = c("taxon_capture", "life_stage_simple", ".draw")) %>%
  left_join(sigma_spp_lss_draws %>%
              select(taxon_capture,
                     life_stage_simple,
                     .draw,
                     sigma), by = c("taxon_capture", "life_stage_simple", ".draw"))



# # load linpred draws
# # NOTE: 03 uses re_formula = NA, so these draws are not equivalent to the above
# spp_lss_draws = read_parquet(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "unified_03_b_spp_lss_draws.parquet"))

```

```{r}
ggplot(spp_lss_draws, aes(x = sigma)) +
```

# calculate metrics
```{r}
spp_lss_agg = spp_lss_draws %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple) %>%
  summarise(hu_lss_mean = mean(hu),
            mu_lss_mean = mean(mu),
            sigma_lss_mean = mean(sigma),
            hu_lss_sd = sd(hu),
            mu_lss_sd = sd(mu),
            sigma_lss_sd = sd(sigma),
            .groups = "drop")

# average across life stages within each draw first, then summarise across draws,
# so the sd reflects the covariance between adult and subadult draws
spp_agg = spp_lss_draws %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, .draw) %>%
  summarise(hu = mean(hu),
            sigma = mean(sigma),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
  summarise(hu_mean = mean(hu),
            hu_sd = sd(hu),
            sigma_mean = mean(sigma),
            sigma_sd = sd(sigma))

spp_contrast_agg = spp_lss_draws %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("taxon_capture", ".draw"),
              names_from = "life_stage_simple",
              values_from = c("hu", "mu", "sigma")) %>%
  mutate(contrast = "subadult - adult",
         hu_contrast = hu_subadult - hu_adult,
         mu_contrast = mu_subadult - mu_adult) %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
  summarise(contrast = dplyr::first(contrast),
            hu_contrast_mean = mean(hu_contrast),
            hu_contrast_sd = sd(hu_contrast),
            mu_contrast_mean = mean(mu_contrast),
            mu_contrast_sd = sd(mu_contrast),
            .groups = "drop")

metrics_agg = spp_agg %>%
  left_join(spp_contrast_agg, by = "taxon_capture")

metrics_ls = metrics_agg %>%
  left_join(ls_clean, by = "taxon_capture")

```

# checks
```{r}
# Names in your covariance matrix
mat_names = rownames(jp_phylo_cov)

# Names in your data
data_names = unique(metrics_ls$taxon_capture)

# Check for mismatches
setdiff(data_names, mat_names)  # in data but not matrix
setdiff(mat_names, data_names)  # in matrix but not data

# within-species correlation of estimation error between responses.
# se() treats each response's sd as independent; large |r| here means
# the meta-model understates shared measurement error across responses
spp_error_cor = spp_lss_draws %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("taxon_capture", ".draw"),
              names_from = "life_stage_simple",
              values_from = c("hu", "mu", "sigma")) %>%
  mutate(hu = (hu_adult + hu_subadult) / 2,
         sigma = (sigma_adult + sigma_subadult) / 2,
         hu_contrast = hu_subadult - hu_adult,
         mu_contrast = mu_subadult - mu_adult) %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
  summarise(r_hu_hucontrast = cor(hu, hu_contrast),
            r_hu_mucontrast = cor(hu, mu_contrast),
            r_hu_sigma = cor(hu, sigma),
            r_hucontrast_mucontrast = cor(hu_contrast, mu_contrast),
            r_hucontrast_sigma = cor(hu_contrast, sigma),
            r_mucontrast_sigma = cor(mu_contrast, sigma),
            .groups = "drop")

spp_error_cor %>%
  pivot_longer(-taxon_capture, names_to = "pair", values_to = "r") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = r, y = pair)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Within-species posterior correlation", y = NULL)
```

# Model
```{r}
# measurement error via se(sd, sigma = TRUE): y ~ N(mu, sqrt(sigma^2 + sd^2)).
# equivalent to mi(sd) on the response, but integrates out the latent true values
# so log_lik is per observation and LOO is valid

m1_lspr = brm(
  mvbf(
    hu_mean | se(hu_sd, sigma = TRUE) ~ habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
    hu_contrast_mean | se(hu_contrast_sd, sigma = TRUE) ~ habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
    mu_contrast_mean | se(mu_contrast_sd, sigma = TRUE)  ~ habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
    sigma_mean | se(sigma_sd, sigma = TRUE) ~ habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
    rescor = FALSE
  ),
  data  = metrics_ls,
  data2 = list(A = jp_phylo_cov),
  # control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  seed = 124,
  cores = 4,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE)
)

m1_lspr = add_criterion(m1_lspr, "loo", moment_match = TRUE)

saveRDS(m1_lspr, file = here("size_bd_unified/unified_models/meta_model_m1_lspr.rds"))
m1_lspr = readRDS(file = here("size_bd_unified/unified_models/meta_model_m1_lspr.rds"))

m1b_lspr = brm(
  mvbf(
    hu_mean | se(hu_sd, sigma = TRUE) ~ log_habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
    hu_contrast_mean | se(hu_contrast_sd, sigma = TRUE) ~ log_habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
    mu_contrast_mean | se(mu_contrast_sd, sigma = TRUE)  ~ log_habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
    sigma_mean | se(sigma_sd, sigma = TRUE) ~ log_habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
    rescor = FALSE
  ),
  data  = metrics_ls,
  data2 = list(A = jp_phylo_cov),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.98),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  cores = 4,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE)
)

m1b_lspr = add_criterion(m1b_lspr, "loo", moment_match = TRUE)

saveRDS(m1b_lspr, file = here("size_bd_unified/unified_models/meta_model_m1b_lspr.rds"))
m1b_lspr = readRDS(file = here("size_bd_unified/unified_models/meta_model_m1b_lspr.rds"))

# m1c (lognormal for sigma) removed: sigma_mean is log(sigma) from linpred_draws
# (link scale, can be negative), so gaussian is the correct family and m1c == m1b

# include development mode
m1d_lspr = brm(
  mvbf(
    bf(hu_mean | se(hu_sd, sigma = TRUE) ~ log_habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + development_stage + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
       family = gaussian()),
    bf(hu_contrast_mean | se(hu_contrast_sd, sigma = TRUE) ~ log_habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + development_stage + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
       family = gaussian()),
    bf(mu_contrast_mean | se(mu_contrast_sd, sigma = TRUE)  ~ log_habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + development_stage + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
       family = gaussian()),
    bf(sigma_mean | se(sigma_sd, sigma = TRUE) ~ log_habitat_breadth + aquatic_index + development_stage + (1 | p | gr(taxon_capture, cov = A)),
       family = gaussian()),
    rescor = FALSE
  ),
  data  = metrics_ls,
  data2 = list(A = jp_phylo_cov),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.98),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  cores = 4,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE)
)

m1d_lspr = add_criterion(m1d_lspr, "loo", moment_match = TRUE)

saveRDS(m1d_lspr, file = here("size_bd_unified/unified_models/meta_model_m1d_lspr.rds"))
m1d_lspr = readRDS(file = here("size_bd_unified/unified_models/meta_model_m1d_lspr.rds"))

```

# model evaluation
```{r}
model_select = m1d_lspr
summary(model_select)
plot((model_select), ask = FALSE)
plot(conditional_effects(model_select), ask = FALSE)
VarCorr(m1_lspr)

# phylogenetic signal per response: sd_phylo^2 / (sd_phylo^2 + sigma^2)
# (mv model has per-response sd and sigma; sigma excludes the known se)
hyp_hu = paste("sd_taxon_capture__humean_Intercept^2 /",
             "(sd_taxon_capture__humean_Intercept^2 + sigma_humean^2) = 0")
hyp_mu_contrast = paste("sd_taxon_capture__mucontrastmean_Intercept^2 /",
             "(sd_taxon_capture__mucontrastmean_Intercept^2 + sigma_mucontrastmean^2) = 0")
hyp_hu_contrast = paste("sd_taxon_capture__hucontrastmean_Intercept^2 /",
             "(sd_taxon_capture__hucontrastmean_Intercept^2 + sigma_hucontrastmean^2) = 0")
hyp_sigma = paste("sd_taxon_capture__sigmamean_Intercept^2 /",
             "(sd_taxon_capture__sigmamean_Intercept^2 + sigma_sigmamean^2) = 0")

# all responses in one table
hypothesis(model_select, c(hu = hyp_hu,
                           hu_contrast = hyp_hu_contrast,
                           mu_contrast = hyp_mu_contrast,
                           sigma = hyp_sigma), class = NULL)

ht_hu_contrast = hypothesis(m1d_lspr, hyp_hu_contrast, class = NULL)
ht_mu_contrast = hypothesis(m1d_lspr, hyp_mu_contrast, class = NULL)
ht_hu = hypothesis(m1d_lspr, hyp_hu, class = NULL)
ht_sigma = hypothesis(m1d_lspr, hyp_sigma, class = NULL)

ht_hu_contrast
ht_mu_contrast
ht_hu
ht_sigma
```

# visualize
```{r}
m_fixed_draws = model_select %>%
  gather_draws(`b_.*`, regex = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!grepl("Intercept", .variable)) %>%
  separate(.variable, into = c("prefix", "response", "term"),
           sep = "_", extra = "merge")

ggplot(m_fixed_draws, aes(x = .value, y = term, color = response, fill = response)) +
  stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.6, .width = c(0.5, 0.89), density = "bounded", normalize = "panels") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ response, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Posterior estimate", y = NULL,
       title = "Fixed effects across responses",
       fill = NULL,
       color = NULL)
```

# explore specific groups
```{r}
#| eval: false
# stale: written for an earlier meta-model (fit_mv / meta_summary no longer exist).
# kept for reference; update to model_select and current predictors before running.

# Example: IUCN category effect on hu_mean
iucn_grid <- expand_grid(
    iucn_redlist_category = unique(meta_summary$iucn_redlist_category),
    development_stage     = "larval",          # hold constant
    pop_trend_present     = "stable",                # hold at reference
    max_svl_mm            = median(meta_summary$max_svl_mm)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hu_sd             = 0.01,
    hu_subadult_sd    = 0.01,
    b_subadult_sd     = 0.01,
    sigma_sd          = 0.01
  )

# re_formula = NA marginalizes over phylogenetic RE
iucn_draws <- iucn_grid %>%
  add_epred_draws(fit_mv,
                  re_formula = NA,
                  resp = "husubadultmean")

iucn_draws %>%
  group_by(iucn_redlist_category) %>%
  median_qi(.epred, .width = c(0.5, 0.89)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = iucn_redlist_category, y = .epred,
             ymin = .lower, ymax = .upper)) +
  geom_pointrange() +
  theme_classic()


```
